plugins.name: local
plugins.description: soma-work local plugin — the bot-bound half of the former zworkflow plugin (z pipeline, hook-proxy, Slack delivery, LLM-proxy agents). Bundled default of the soma-work bot; needs the bot's MCP servers.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: soma-work core plugin — standalone skills and agents (no MCP, no soma-work service, no LLM proxy). Membership enforced by the dependency-closure test. Bundled default of the soma-work bot and installable anywhere.
